text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Takamatsunomiya Kinen—and the first round of the Cutie ♪ Derby—is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taking inspiration from Curren Chan's videos, Biko Pegasus has also leveled up her hero videos for the big day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Curren Chan, on the other hand, presses on as usual with cute videos.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After admiring and praising each other's work, they both declare the intent to take first place.
